# Gift it now or leave it in the will? The tax on each path.

> Free calculator: should you gift a house or stock to your child now or let them inherit it? Compares carryover basis against the stepped-up basis, the capital gains tax, Form 709 and estate tax. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
